hooks.text: 近战、射击、装备与三种战斗风格共同应对高密度弹幕和首领
hooks.excerpt: Use a combination of melee, shooting, a variety of equipment and 3 distinct battle styles to fight a multitude of enemies and bosses in intense bullet hell combat!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 被净化的敌人会转为同伴力量，跑局材料还能用于永久强化和制作新装备
hooks.excerpt: Your abilities are limited on their own, but you can make use of the power of your foes-returned-friends! Use materials obtained from runs to increase your strength and craft new equipment, preparing you for greater challenges ahead!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 首领连战、无尽神社扫荡与高难附加关卡分别提供纯首领、群怪和技巧试炼
hooks.excerpt: Take on boss battle after boss battle in Boss Rush, or endless waves of enemies in Shrine Sweep! Optional Extra Stages are also available as high difficulty trials; currently two, with more in store for the future!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
